tools.name: cogmento_get_current_user
tools.description: The Cogmento user this API token belongs to: id, name, email, timezone and account id. GET /auth/user/.

tools.name: cogmento_get_account
tools.description: The Cogmento account: name, country, settings, billing plan, trial days left and number of users. GET /account/.

tools.name: cogmento_get_templates
tools.description: The field definitions (names, labels, types, options) of the account's templates for each record type: contacts, companies, deals, cases, tasks. Use it to learn the custom field names for filters, creates and field updates. GET /templates/.

tools.name: cogmento_list_contacts
tools.description: List or search contacts (name, email and phone channels, company). Filter on any field, e.g. first_name contains 'Eric'. GET /contacts/.

tools.name: cogmento_get_contact
tools.description: One full contact record, including its related tasks, cases, calls, events and documents. GET /contacts/{id}/.

tools.name: cogmento_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact. Needs first and last name; email and phone are optional. POST /contacts/.

tools.name: cogmento_list_companies
tools.description: List or search companies (name, website, contacts). GET /companies/.

tools.name: cogmento_get_company
tools.description: One full company record with its contacts and related records. GET /companies/{id}/.

tools.name: cogmento_create_company
tools.description: WRITE: create a company. POST /companies/.

tools.name: cogmento_list_deals
tools.description: List or search deals (title, amount, close date, assigned users, products). GET /deals/.

tools.name: cogmento_get_deal
tools.description: One full deal record with its contacts, products and related records. GET /deals/{id}/.

tools.name: cogmento_create_deal
tools.description: WRITE: create a deal. POST /deals/.

tools.name: cogmento_get_deal_pipeline_summary
tools.description: Totals by pipeline stage: how many deals sit at each stage and what they are worth. Optional filters narrow the deals counted. GET /deals/summary/.

tools.name: cogmento_aggregate_deals
tools.description: Sums and counts deals grouped by a field (default grouping as Cogmento chooses; e.g. field=stage). GET /deals/aggregate/.

tools.name: cogmento_list_deal_stages
tools.description: The account-wide stages a contact can be at within a deal (for example Champion or Decision maker). GET /deals/stages/.

tools.name: cogmento_set_deal_contact_stage
tools.description: WRITE: record where a contact sits in a deal (a stage from cogmento_list_deal_stages). The contact is attached to the deal if it is not already. POST /deals/{id}/contact/{id}/stage/.

tools.name: cogmento_list_tasks
tools.description: List or search tasks (title, due date, completion date, assigned users, linked deal/contact/case). Filter e.g. on due_date. GET /tasks/.

tools.name: cogmento_get_task
tools.description: One task record. GET /tasks/{id}/.

tools.name: cogmento_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task. POST /tasks/.

tools.name: cogmento_complete_task
tools.description: WRITE: mark a task complete, stamping who completed it and when. A recurring task also gets its next occurrence. POST /tasks/{id}/complete/.

tools.name: cogmento_list_cases
tools.description: List or search cases (support or project cases: title, close date, assigned users, deal, company). GET /cases/.

tools.name: cogmento_get_case
tools.description: One case record. GET /cases/{id}/.

tools.name: cogmento_create_case
tools.description: WRITE: create a case. POST /cases/.

tools.name: cogmento_list_products
tools.description: List the product catalogue (name, prices) that deals and invoices draw on. GET /products/.

tools.name: cogmento_list_calls
tools.description: The account's call records, most recent first: logged manual calls and calls placed through the browser dialer. GET /calls/.

tools.name: cogmento_update_record_field
tools.description: WRITE: change a single field of a contact, company, deal, task or case, e.g. a deal's status or a contact's first_name. Custom field names come from cogmento_get_templates. System fields (id, acl, private, timestamps) are refused. PATCH /<type>/{id}/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cogmento_get_current_user, cogmento_list_contacts · Private data: cogmento_get_current_user, cogmento_get_templates, cogmento_list_contacts, cogmento_get_contact, cogmento_create_contact, cogmento_list_companies, cogmento_get_company, cogmento_get_deal, cogmento_list_deal_stages, cogmento_set_deal_contact_stage, cogmento_list_tasks, cogmento_get_task, cogmento_get_case, cogmento_list_calls, cogmento_update_record_field · Public sink: cogmento_get_current_user, cogmento_list_contacts, cogmento_create_contact, cogmento_create_company, cogmento_create_deal, cogmento_set_deal_contact_stage, cogmento_create_task, cogmento_complete_task, cogmento_create_case.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cogmento_get_current_user, cogmento_list_contacts · Private data: cogmento_get_current_user, cogmento_get_templates, cogmento_list_contacts, cogmento_get_contact, cogmento_create_contact, cogmento_list_companies, cogmento_get_company, cogmento_get_deal, cogmento_list_deal_stages, cogmento_set_deal_contact_stage, cogmento_list_tasks, cogmento_get_task, cogmento_get_case, cogmento_list_calls, cogmento_update_record_field · Public sink: cogmento_get_current_user, cogmento_list_contacts, cogmento_create_contact, cogmento_create_company, cogmento_create_deal, cogmento_set_deal_contact_stage, cogmento_create_task, cogmento_complete_task, cogmento_create_case

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
